# Security Policy

## Supported versions

| Version branch | Supported |
|----------------|-----------|
| `main` (1.21.1) | Yes |
| `1.20.1` | Yes |
| `26.2` | Best effort (beta Minecraft) |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not** open a public issue for security vulnerabilities or include
exploit details in public discussion before maintainers can investigate.

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/MeherBenSalem/CivilizationAI/security/advisories/new)
for this repository.

Include:

- Affected Minecraft / loader versions
- Impact summary
- Steps to reproduce (privately)
- Whether an API key or player data could be exposed

We will acknowledge reports as soon as practical and coordinate a fix and
disclosure timeline.
